note: Writable field: passes. Do not edit acceptance, description or id to make a check pass - report instead.

features.title: Build-loop harness scripts
features.description: harness.ps1 with check (static) / verify (typecheck, vitest, smoke, background, logs) / report (one line per check) / tick / untick / next. Logs under .harness/logs, git-ignored.
acceptance: harness.ps1 check runs every .py checker found in .harness/checks and prints PASS or ERROR per check
harness.ps1 verify runs typecheck, then vitest, then smoke, writing one summary line per step
harness.ps1 report prints PASS/ERROR per step from the summaries only
harness.ps1 tick/untick change only the passes field of feature_list.json
harness.ps1 next prints the highest-priority unpassed feature whose deps pass

features.title: Zero-thickness face recipe (schema 6)
features.description: Face is its own recipe kind (points + plane + matrix), meshed by packages/geometry/src/face.ts, zero volume, counted by area, push/pull converts it to a loop of the same ring, DXF import emits faces, picking hits from the visible side.
acceptance: rectangle, circle, polygon, arc, rotated rectangle create a face with zero volume
push/pull on a face produces a loop extrusion of the same ring and plane
outliner shows Face with area in cm2, never a volume of 0
addFace refuses <3 points, zero area, zero-length normal
a 5-file loads and reports version 6
packages/engine/test/face.test.ts and packages/geometry/test/face.test.ts pass

features.title: First real gate run
features.description: Typecheck, the whole vitest suite and the smoke script run once in the background; docs/13-test-plan.md Results filled from real output; every failure either fixed in the same or next cycle or recorded with a reason.
acceptance: harness.ps1 report shows PASS for typecheck, tests and smoke
docs/13-test-plan.md Results table holds real case rows, no placeholder text
every earlier-written-but-never-run suite has run at least once

features.title: Line tool
features.description: Chains clicks into edges; closing on the start vertex creates a face; typed length moves the next point along the current direction.
acceptance: each click adds an edge preview and snaps to endpoints like other tools
clicking the start vertex (or Enter) closes the ring and creates a face
typed length places the next point at exactly that distance in the current direction
Escape cancels without leaving a partial object
undo removes the whole chain in one step

features.title: Inference wiring + glyphs
features.description: inference.ts already computes endpoint/midpoint/axis locks; wire it to the pointer so every tool snaps, and draw the glyphs (endpoint square, midpoint diamond, on-edge, axis colour).
acceptance: pointer snaps to endpoints and midpoints of existing edges within a screen-space tolerance
axis lock lines appear in red/green/blue depending on the locked axis
Shift still forces the square constraint on rectangle and line
a status hint names the active inference

features.title: Offset tool
features.description: 2D inset/outset of a polygon ring by a typed distance, producing a new face or ring.
acceptance: offset of a convex ring by d has area differing from the original by the expected amount
offset that would self-intersect is refused with a message
negative (inward) and positive (outward) both work
result is one undoable step

features.title: Follow-me
features.description: Sweep a profile along a path (edges chain or a clicked path) to build a solid.
acceptance: sweeping a rectangle along a straight path equals the equivalent extrusion
a path perpendicular to the profile is accepted, a path parallel to it is refused
result is watertight per inspectMesh
one undo step

features.title: Dimension tool
features.description: Linear dimension between two points, placed with a third click, text editable, drawn in the annotations layer, saved in the file.
acceptance: dimension length equals the distance between its endpoints in the chosen unit
editing the text persists through save/open
dragging a dimension updates the drawn offset, not the measured value unless endpoints move
one undo step per dimension

features.title: Tape measure
features.description: Shows live length while dragging and a typed length creates a guide line (not geometry).
acceptance: live length updates while dragging
typing a length then Enter creates a guide line of exactly that length
guide lines are visible, selectable for delete, and never counted in quantity
saved in the file

features.title: Sticky geometry + coplanar weld
features.description: Chamfer/fillet edges and weld coplanar faces after booleans so edits produce clean solids.
acceptance: boolean of two flush boxes yields a solid whose mesh has no internal faces
chamfer on a chosen edge changes the volume by the expected amount
fillet radius larger than the adjacent face is refused
one undo step

features.title: Clearance check
features.description: Report pairs of objects closer than a threshold distance.
acceptance: two objects 50 mm apart with a 100 mm clearance rule are reported
two objects 150 mm apart are not reported
touching objects report 0, not a negative distance
report lists both ids and the measured gap

features.title: BOM and cut list
features.description: Per-object quantity: volume, area, longest edge, material; grouped by tag or definition, exportable as CSV.
acceptance: a face contributes area, never a volume
instances of one definition are grouped with a count
CSV export round-trips numbers with the file's unit
grouped rows sum to the whole-model total

features.title: Scaled PDF sheet
features.description: Export the current view as a page at a chosen scale (1:50 etc.) with a title block.
acceptance: a 1000 mm wall prints 20 mm long at 1:50
the chosen scale is printed in the title block
changing scale does not change model units
export completes without a browser download prompt in the desktop build

features.title: Soften/smooth edges (Ctrl)
features.description: Ctrl during an operation softens the affected edges; softened edges are hidden in Shaded and drawn dotted in Edges Only.
acceptance: softened edge is not drawn as a hard line in Shaded
softened edges survive save/open
Ctrl is a modifier like Shift and does not break typing
softening is one undo step
